confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kolkata price levels, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee) are the most reliable. Accommodation is less certain because guesthouse and 3-star rates vary widely by neighbourhood, season and booking channel. Beer is a rough estimate given Indian alcohol taxes. Cocktail and wine are weaker: they were set relative to the beer anchor, with cocktail at about twice the beer price and wine glass near the cocktail price, reflecting typical Indian bar and restaurant markups.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are placed within the range of other large Indian metropolitan cities, at the lower-cost end of that group relative to Delhi and Mumbai tourist areas.
